CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to content organization/presentation/access was stated.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified and its organized coordinate pattern is given, with a separate origin/status field for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No text links an attention/allocation condition to the identified contents' organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content items (color attributes with coordinate sets) are named for specific referents and times.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields explicitly distinguish identification records/processes from the content coordinate listings.

O.rationale: Coordinate sets describe how contents are presented or organized for specific referents and times.
